predecessors.name: Kakatiya dynasty
predecessors.text: the coastal belt of the former Kakatiya empire south of the Krishna

successors.name: Gajapati Kingdom
successors.text: Rajahmundry and its country, short of Telangana

ledger.x: 1325: Prolaya Vema Reddi founds the Reddi kingdom at Addanki.
1328: the capital moves from Addanki to the fortified Kondavidu.
1395: a Reddi branch is set up at Rajahmundry.
1424: the surviving Reddis rule from Rajahmundry.
1448: the Gajapatis take Rajahmundry and end the Reddi kingdom.

wars.name: Vijayanagara annexation of Kondavidu
wars.outcome: Kondavidu was annexed by Vijayanagara in 1424; Deva Raya II fought Bhanudeva IV (the Ganga king) at Kondavidu c.

wars.name: Gajapati conquest of Rajahmundry
wars.outcome: Rajahmundry came under Kapilendra before 1448, ending the Reddi kingdom.

wars.name: Reddi wars with the Recherlas and Bahmanis
wars.outcome: The page names 'the regular invasions of Recherla Velama rulers and their Bahamani allies' as the reason for the move to Kondavidu; no dated battle or territory.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line is on any page; the Rajahmundry branch's frontier and the extent 'from Cuttack to Kanchi' are approximate.
